guardLocations.setSelectedValues_generation_and_disconn: packages/core/src/components/enhanced-select.ts _loadSelectedItemsByValues — `if (generation !== this._asyncGeneration || !this.isConnected) return;` on success and reject branches; finally only clears busy when current+connected
guardLocations.acknowledged_stale_completion: packages/core/src/data-loading/request-coordinator.ts completeDataRequest — inactive/unknown requestId routes to classifyInactiveRequest returning 'stale'/'unknown-request' (not 'accepted'); component only projects on 'accepted'

characterized: Two overlapping setSelectedValues server fetches; resolving the NEWER first then the OLDER (stale) with a DIFFERENT non-benign item leaves exactly the newer selection and emits exactly one change (stale 'first' does not overwrite 'second').
Stale success resolving after a newer success: no value overwrite and no additional change event.
Stale FAILURE (older rejects after newer succeeds): swallowed — no error event, selection stays the newer value.
Disconnect mid-flight with a real resolved item: no change/error/select events and no selection change (the detached non-benign result is dropped).

Acknowledged stale completion after the request is superseded by a new query: completeDataRequest returns 'stale', no dataProjection, status stays 'loading' (not advanced to succeeded); the current request then completes with 'accepted' and a single 'complete' projection.
Acknowledged completion from an unknown request identity: rejected (not 'accepted'), no projection, status stays 'loading'.
